task: FV2-022 — Flutter Design V2 protected image viewer overlay parity
summary: Implemented a responsive, viewport-filling Flutter protected image viewer aligned to the web overlay. Preserved authenticated image loading and the separate protected save action. No web, API, ACL, storage, conversation, or media behavior changed.

checks.name: Test-first viewer states and responsive geometry
checks.observation: Re-run on the tree including origin/master ba9d8e89. Desktop 1440×900 and compact 390×844 overlay bounds, header/filename, close target, separate download visibility, fit-to-window stage, transient error retry, unavailable state, and malformed image decode retry are covered. New regressions failed before the corresponding implementation changes.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite
checks.observation: PASS before synchronizing the later origin/master microphone-controls merge.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite after origin/master microphone-controls merge
checks.observation: On merged revision 9f2b6e3b (origin/master ba9d8e89 plus the viewer commit), 73 widget tests ended with 'A Timer is still pending'. The stack traces pointed to the new 500 ms Future.timeout in NativeMicrophoneControls.configure while the FlutterWebRTC.Method test channel was unresolved under FakeAsync. The test-only harness regression was resolved as FE-71/T-077 — [QA-265](qa265-flutter-native-audio-test-harness-2026-10-05-001.json); no microphone runtime implementation was changed.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite after FE-71 test-harness fix
checks.observation: All tests pass after the test-only MethodChannel fixture and the long-list audio settings test switched from a fixed scroll distance to targeting the relevant sections. The runtime microphone implementation was not changed.
